name: Navy
overview: Scripture reveals the role of navies in both commerce and conflict through specific historical examples. Solomon established a navy at Eziongeber by the Red Sea, facilitating trade and resource acquisition, while Hiram's navy brought valuable goods such as gold, almug trees, and precious stones from Ophir. In prophetic passages, the navy of Chittim and numerous ships associated with the king of the north are depicted as instruments in end-time conflicts, highlighting the strategic and symbolic significance of naval forces in God's unfolding plan.
